svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Boards: cut two 1060 x 70 mm strips of 6 mm HDPE; round the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: corners to 10 mm and chamfer the inner top edge 2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 6.5 mm holes in each, 40 mm from the inner edge, at 30, 370,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 710 and 1030 mm from the rear end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spacers: eight 13 mm lengths of 12 x 2 mm aluminium tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: each board on four spacers on the rail top, M6 x 25 button-head

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws into the rail's rivet nuts. The board's inner edge lies 5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: over the belt edge and 3 mm above it; its rear end 60 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: slide a 2 mm feeler between board and belt along its length.
